011/**
012 * Automatic tester that executes test cases for DayPlanner features, invariants, and exceptions.
013 */
014public class Tester {
015    /**
016     * Counter of test cases that passed.
017     */
018    private static int passedCount = 0;
019
020    /**
021     * Counter of test cases that failed.
022     */
023    private static int failedCount = 0;
024
025
026
027    /**
028     * Main entry point for executing all test cases.
029     * @param args Command-line arguments.
030     */
031    public static void main(String[] args) {
032        System.out.println("Executing Tester.java");
033        
034        runTestCase("case01", "Command Loop: Invalid Command", testCase01());
035        runTestCase("case02", "Command Loop: Case & Alias Recognition", testCase02());
036        runTestCase("case03", "Time Validation: Non-leap February 29", testCase03());
037        runTestCase("case04", "Time Validation: Leap Year February 29", testCase04());
038        runTestCase("case05", "Time Validation: Month Day Overflow", testCase05());
039        runTestCase("case06", "Time Validation: Component Bounds", testCase06());
040        runTestCase("case07", "Chronological Validation: Start Before End", testCase07());
041        runTestCase("case08", "Defensive Input: Blank Title & Blank Location", testCase08());
042        runTestCase("case09", "Add Activity: Complete Flow", testCase09());
043        runTestCase("case10", "Search: Element at Beginning of List", testCase10());
044        runTestCase("case11", "Search: Element in Middle of List", testCase11());
045        runTestCase("case12", "Search: Element at End of List", testCase12());
046        runTestCase("case13", "Search: Element Not on List", testCase13());
047        runTestCase("case14", "Keyword Matching: Word-Level Exactness", testCase14());
048        runTestCase("case15", "Keyword Matching: Case & Order Invariance", testCase15());
049        runTestCase("case16", "Time Period: Bounded Range", testCase16());
050        runTestCase("case17", "Time Period: Open End Range", testCase17());
051        runTestCase("case18", "Time Period: Open Start Range", testCase18());
052        runTestCase("case19", "Time Period: Invalid Inverted Range", testCase19());
053        runTestCase("case20", "Search: No Filters (Match All)", testCase20());
054        runTestCase("case21", "Title Index: Activity Addition", testCase21());
055        runTestCase("case22", "Persistence Verification (RAS Read/Write)", testCase22());
056
057        // Exception-handling test cases (Assignment 4)
058        runTestCase("case23", "Exception: Time Constructor Throws IllegalArgumentException on Bad Year",   testCase23());
059        runTestCase("case24", "Exception: Time Constructor Throws IllegalArgumentException on Bad Month",  testCase24());
060        runTestCase("case25", "Exception: Time Constructor Throws IllegalArgumentException on Bad Day",    testCase25());
061        runTestCase("case26", "Exception: Time Constructor Throws IllegalArgumentException on Bad Hour",   testCase26());
062        runTestCase("case27", "Exception: Time Constructor Throws IllegalArgumentException on Bad Minute", testCase27());
063        runTestCase("case28", "Exception: Time.compareTo Throws NullPointerException for Null Argument",  testCase28());
064        runTestCase("case29", "Exception: Time.compareTo Throws ClassCastException for Wrong Class",      testCase29());
065        runTestCase("case30", "Exception: Activity Constructor Throws on Null/Blank Title",               testCase30());
066        runTestCase("case31", "Exception: Activity Constructor Throws on Null Start/End Time",            testCase31());
067        runTestCase("case32", "Exception: Activity Constructor Throws When Start >= End",                 testCase32());
068        runTestCase("case33", "Exception: OtherActivity Throws on Null/Blank Location",                  testCase33());
069        runTestCase("case34", "Exception: Input.readInt Recovers from Non-Integer Input",                 testCase34());
070        runTestCase("case35", "Exception: Time Mutators Throw IllegalArgumentException on Bad Values",    testCase35());
071
072        // Inheritance, Abstract Classes & Polymorphism test cases (Assignment 3, requirement 3a)
073        runTestCase("case36", "Abstract Class: Activity is Abstract and Cannot be Instantiated Directly", testCase36());
074        runTestCase("case37", "Polymorphism: Dynamic Binding via toString and getType on Activity List",  testCase37());
075
076        System.out.printf(String.format("Out of %d tests, %d passed and %d failed\n",
077            passedCount + failedCount, passedCount, failedCount));
078    }

082    /**
083     * Records and prints the outcome of a single test case.
084     * @param id The test case identifier.
085     * @param description Short description of what was tested.
086     * @param pass Whether the test passed.
087     */
088    public static void runTestCase(String id, String description, boolean pass) {
089        if (pass) {
090            passedCount++;
091            System.out.printf("[pass] %s: %s\n", id, description);
092        } else {
093            failedCount++;
094            System.out.printf("[FAIL] %s: %s\n", id, description);
095        }
096    }

100    /**
101     * Case 01: Verifies that unrecognized commands are rejected by the command loop.
102     * @return <code>true</code> if the test passes, <code>false</code> otherwise.
103     */
104    public static boolean testCase01() {
105        java.io.PrintStream originalOut = System.out;
106        System.setOut(new java.io.PrintStream(new java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream()));
107        try {
108            Input input = new Input(new ByteArrayInputStream("bye\n".getBytes()));
109            String cmd = input.readCommand();
110            return MenuOption.parse(cmd) == null;
111        } finally {
112            System.setOut(originalOut);
113        }
114    }
115
116    /**
117     * Case 02: Verifies that command aliases and case variations are recognized.
118     * @return <code>true</code> if the test passes, <code>false</code> otherwise.
119     */
120    public static boolean testCase02() {
121        String[] addAliases = { "add", "ADD", "Add", "a", "A", "1", "insert" };
122        String[] searchAliases = { "search", "SEARCH", "Search", "s", "S", "2", "find" };
123        String[] quitAliases = { "quit", "QUIT", "Quit", "q", "Q", "3" };
124
125        for (String a : addAliases) {
126            if (MenuOption.parse(a) != MenuOption.ADD)
127                return false;
128        }
129
130        for (String s : searchAliases) {
131            if (MenuOption.parse(s) != MenuOption.SEARCH)
132                return false;
133        }
134
135        for (String q : quitAliases) {
136            if (MenuOption.parse(q) != MenuOption.QUIT)
137                return false;
138        }
139
140        return true;
141    }

143    /**
144     * Case 03: Verifies that February 29 is rejected in non-leap years.
145     * @return <code>true</code> if the test passes, <code>false</code> otherwise.
146     */
147    public static boolean testCase03() {
148        boolean valid = Time.isValidTime(2026, 2, 29, 10, 0);
149        String err = Time.getValidationError(2026, 2, 29, 10, 0);
150        return !valid && err != null && err.contains("max 28 days");
151    }

157    public static boolean testCase04() {
158        boolean isLeap = Time.isLeapYear(2024);

173    /**
174     * Case 06: Verifies that out-of-bounds time components are rejected.
175     * @return <code>true</code> if the test passes, <code>false</code> otherwise.
176     */
177    public static boolean testCase06() {
178        boolean badMonth = !Time.isValidTime(2026, 13, 1, 10, 0);
179        boolean badHour = !Time.isValidTime(2026, 5, 10, 24, 0);
180        boolean badMinute = !Time.isValidTime(2026, 5, 10, 12, 60);
181        boolean badYear = !Time.isValidTime(0, 1, 1, 10, 0);
182        return badMonth && badHour && badMinute && badYear;
183    }

375    /**
376     * Case 22: Verifies serializing activities to RAS format and reading them back.
377     * @return <code>true</code> if the test passes, <code>false</code> otherwise.
378     */
379    public static boolean testCase22() {
380        String testDir;
381        try {
382            testDir = java.nio.file.Files.createTempDirectory("dayplanner-test-").toString();
383        } catch (java.io.IOException e) {
384            return false;
385        }
386        String testFile = "test_persistence.ras";
387
388        ActivityList outList = new ActivityList();
389        Time t1 = new Time(2026, 10, 1, 10, 0);
390        Time t2 = new Time(2026, 10, 1, 11, 0);
391
392        HomeActivity ha = new HomeActivity("Test Home", t1, t2, "Home Comment");
393        SchoolActivity sa = new SchoolActivity("Test School", t1, t2, "School Comment");
394        OtherActivity oa = new OtherActivity("Test Other", t1, t2, "Other Comment", "Library");
395
396        outList.add(ha);
397        outList.add(sa);
398        outList.add(oa);
399
400        boolean saved = outList.saveToRAS(testDir, testFile);
401        if (!saved) return false;
402
403        ActivityList inList = new ActivityList(testDir, testFile);
404        boolean sizeMatches = inList.size() == 3;
405        boolean equalData = inList.get(0).equals(ha) &&
406                            inList.get(1).equals(sa) &&
407                            inList.get(2).equals(oa);
408
409        // Clean up test file and directory
410        try {
411            Files.deleteIfExists(Path.of(testDir, testFile));
412            Files.deleteIfExists(Path.of(testDir));
413        } catch (IOException e) {
414            // ignore lol
415        }
416
417        return sizeMatches && equalData
418            && inList.findTitleMatches(new String[] { "Test" }).equals(java.util.Arrays.asList(0, 1, 2));
419    }

631        Time t2 = new Time(2026, 10, 1,  9, 0); // before t1
632
633        boolean equalThrew   = false;
634        boolean invertedThrew = false;
635
636        // equal start and end
637        try {
638            new HomeActivity("Test", t1, t1);
639        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
640            equalThrew = true;
641        }
642
643        // start after end
644        try {
645            new HomeActivity("Test", t1, t2);
646        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
647            invertedThrew = true;
648        }
649
650        return equalThrew && invertedThrew;
651    }

681    /**
682     * Case 34: Verifies that Input.readInt() silently recovers from a
683     * non-integer line and returns the first valid integer that follows.
684     * Uses a ByteArrayInputStream so no real keyboard is needed.
685     * 
686     * @return <code>true</code> if the test passes, <code>false</code> otherwise.
687     */
688    public static boolean testCase34() {
689        // Feed: "hello\n42\n" – the first token is not an integer, the second is
690        java.io.InputStream stream =
691            new ByteArrayInputStream("hello\n42\n".getBytes());
692        Input input = new Input(stream);
693
694        // Suppress console output during this test
695        java.io.PrintStream originalOut = System.out;
696        System.setOut(new java.io.PrintStream(new java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream()));
697        try {
698            int result = input.readInt();
699            return result == 42;
700        } finally {
701            System.setOut(originalOut);
702        }
703    }

730    /**
731     * Case 36: Verifies that Activity is declared as an abstract class, so
732     * objects can only be created from the concrete subclasses: HomeActivity,
733     * SchoolActivity, and OtherActivity.
734     * 
735     * @return <code>true</code> if the test passes, <code>false</code> otherwise.
736     */
737    public static boolean testCase36() {
738        // Activity class itself must be abstract
739        boolean activityIsAbstract = java.lang.reflect.Modifier.isAbstract(Activity.class.getModifiers());
740
741        // Concrete subclasses must not be abstract
742        boolean homeConcrete = !java.lang.reflect.Modifier.isAbstract(HomeActivity.class.getModifiers());
743        boolean schoolConcrete = !java.lang.reflect.Modifier.isAbstract(SchoolActivity.class.getModifiers());
744        boolean otherConcrete = !java.lang.reflect.Modifier.isAbstract(OtherActivity.class.getModifiers());
745
746        // Subclasses must inherit from Activity
747        boolean homeExtends = Activity.class.isAssignableFrom(HomeActivity.class);
748        boolean schoolExtends = Activity.class.isAssignableFrom(SchoolActivity.class);
749        boolean otherExtends = Activity.class.isAssignableFrom(OtherActivity.class);
750
751        return activityIsAbstract && homeConcrete && schoolConcrete && otherConcrete
752            && homeExtends && schoolExtends && otherExtends;
753    }

755    /**
756     * Case 37: Verifies effective use of polymorphism through dynamic binding.
757     * Given an ArrayList&lt;Activity&gt; containing HomeActivity, SchoolActivity, and
758     * OtherActivity objects, all details are displayed polymorphically via
759     * toString() without checking class types or using instanceof.
760     * 
761     * @return <code>true</code> if the test passes, <code>false</code> otherwise.
762     */
763    public static boolean testCase37() {
764        Time s1 = new Time(2026, 10, 1, 9, 0);
765        Time e1 = new Time(2026, 10, 1, 10, 0);
766        Time s2 = new Time(2026, 10, 1, 11, 0);
767        Time e2 = new Time(2026, 10, 1, 12, 0);
768        Time s3 = new Time(2026, 10, 1, 13, 0);
769        Time e3 = new Time(2026, 10, 1, 14, 0);
770
771        java.util.ArrayList<Activity> activities = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
772        activities.add(new HomeActivity("Clean Kitchen", s1, e1, "Do dishes"));
773        activities.add(new SchoolActivity("CIS 2430 Lecture", s2, e2, "Room 101"));
774        activities.add(new OtherActivity("Dentist Appointment", s3, e3, "Checkup", "Medical Clinic"));
775
776        // Polymorphic display via toString() and polymorphic getType()
777        // No class type checks or instanceof needed
778        String[] expectedDetails = {
779            "Clean Kitchen (2026/10/01 09:00 - 2026/10/01 10:00) (Do dishes)",
780            "CIS 2430 Lecture (2026/10/01 11:00 - 2026/10/01 12:00) (Room 101)",
781            "Dentist Appointment (2026/10/01 13:00 - 2026/10/01 14:00 at Medical Clinic) (Checkup)"
782        };
783        ActivityType[] expectedTypes = {
784            ActivityType.HOME,
785            ActivityType.SCHOOL,
786            ActivityType.OTHER
787        };
788
789        for (int i = 0; i < activities.size(); i++) {
790            Activity act = activities.get(i);
791            // Dynamic binding invokes the appropriate toString() and getType() implementation
792            String details = act.toString();
793            ActivityType type = act.getType();
794
795            if (!details.equals(expectedDetails[i]))
796                return false;
797            if (type != expectedTypes[i])
798                return false;
799        }
800
801        return true;
802    }
